mission: D9 follow-up (owner decisions 2026-10-17): add three reviewed read-only db-diagnostic files. yuyu-f1-sizing sizes a two-way-unique match rule over stored Yuyu-Tei listing evidence for the ambiguous prints (counts by release and rarity, 20 sample matches); yuyu-f3-aliases lists Yuyu-Tei categories that resolve to no release with sample listings and where PRB reprint codes are listed; storage-savings measures RAW and observation growth to size storage-cutting options. Register them in ops-readonly. Staging only; no rule, alias, proposal, mapping, enqueue, collector, setting, price, identity, Market Value/Index, secret or Railway change; no runbook run in this PR.

impacts.reason: Three SELECT/WITH-only diagnostics (16 statements) over catalogue, mapping, candidate, proposal, freshness, raw_snapshots, raw_snapshot_dictionaries, price_observations and catalogue size views, run only in the existing default_transaction_read_only db-diagnostic session with its statement timeout. No write, no source request.
Adds storage-savings, yuyu-f1-sizing and yuyu-f3-aliases to the diagnostic choice list (the test keeps it equal to scripts/diagnostics). No permission, secret, environment or trigger change.

resources.name: GitHub Actions: ops-readonly db-diagnostic (three new read-only SQL files)

dependencies: ops runbooks from PR #139, #143, #150, #155, #157, #158; diagnostics from PR #156 (unchanged)
impact.deployment_impact: Three read-only diagnostics and their workflow choice entries. collector_services is empty and no raw_dependency_migration: 0 collector rollouts, no DDL. No path under services/, packages/ or apps/ changes.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR removes the three diagnostics and their workflow choices. No data, schema, provider or service configuration to undo.
recovery.trigger: A db-diagnostic run of a new file that fails the read-only check, exceeds its statement timeout, or returns anything but query rows.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue.

verification.observation_window: After merge: one ops-readonly db-diagnostic run per new file completes with status ok, and its ops-summary carries rows or names them in rows_omitted.
